_help: Config for the local Brain index. Empty vault_path/db_path use safe defaults: vault_path = the folder above this one (the Brain root), db_path = ~/Brain-index/brain.db (outside the vault, so Google Drive does not sync a binary on every reindex). Paths may use ~ and environment variables.

embedding._help: Backend-later. Leave provider 'none' for keyword-only search. Set it to 'local-http' and point endpoint/model at a LOCAL embedding server (llama.cpp server or Ollama, OpenAI-compatible /v1/embeddings) to turn on semantic search. Nothing here should be a cloud endpoint; memory does not leave the machine.

_sections_help: Each section is its own wiki: a subfolder indexed into its own database and kept OUT of the main brain index, so bulky reference material does not drown out memory and sessions. Index or search one with `--section <name>`. Empty db_path defaults to ~/Brain-index/<name>.db.

local-ai-master.description: Archived Local AI Master course platform (505 chapters, 531 pages plus blog/model/reference pages). Reference material, its own wiki.
